project.name: Auth Service
project.description: Owns the internal authentication service and its versioned HTTP APIs.

issues.content:
Issue: AUTH-301
Summary: Publish Auth API v1 contract
Type: Story
Status: Done
Assignee: Asha Rao
Reporter: Neel Shah
Labels: api, authentication, production

Description:
Auth Service provides Auth API v1. The production authentication endpoint is POST /v1/auth. MCP Gateway and Argo Orchestrator are approved consumers. Version v1 is the supported production contract until a migration is announced.

issues.summary: Introduce Auth API v2 without removing v1
issues.content:
Issue: AUTH-302
Summary: Introduce Auth API v2 without removing v1
Type: Story
Status: In Progress
Assignee: Asha Rao
Reporter: Neel Shah
Labels: api, authentication, v2

Description:
Add POST /v2/auth as the next authentication contract. This ticket does not remove or deprecate Auth API v1. Both versions must run in parallel until every registered consumer has migrated.
